_how_to_edit: Every suspect needs a name, a sex (male or female) and a value for every trait.
No two people may have the same sex AND the same crime computer traits, or the computer can't tell them apart.
Values work best as short words that several people share.
Each trait's clues are witness sentences; {value} becomes that person's value.
In sentences, {They}/{they}, {Them}/{them} and {Their}/{their} become he/him/his or she/her/her.
phrases (optional) say how witnesses word a value when it doesn't read well on its own.
computer: false marks a trait the crime computer doesn't have. Other is one.
catchphrase (optional) is what they say when you catch them. bio (optional) shows as Notes in their dossier.
skin is optional: light, rosy, olive, tan, brown or dark.
es holds the Spanish (Argentina). On a trait: its label, witness sentences, values and phrases.

traits.label: Hobby
clues: {They} asked if there was anywhere nearby for {value}.
{They} said {they} never missed a weekend of {value}.

es.label: Pasatiempo
clues: Me dijo que lo que más le gusta es {value}.
Preguntó si había algún lugar cerca para {value}.
Dijo que no hay fin de semana sin {value}.

traits.label: Vehicle
clues: {They} said nothing beats getting around by {value}.
How did {they} get here? By {value}, {they} said.

es.label: Vehículo
clues: Dijo que no hay nada como moverse en {value}.

traits.label: Other
clues: I'll tell you one more thing: {they} {value}.

suspects.name: Jon Orlo
suspects.bio: Wanted for suspicious technological activities. His tech skills are matched only by his dubious Japanese.

es.other: se hace el que sabe algo de japonés
es.bio: Buscado por actividades tecnológicas sospechosas. Su talento técnico solo se compara con su dudoso japonés.

suspects.name: Carmen Sandiego
suspects.other: has never been photographed without a red hat
suspects.bio: The original super-thief. Master of disguise, geography and vanishing just as the authorities close in.

es.other: nunca fue fotografiada sin su sombrero rojo
es.bio: La ladrona original. Maestra del disfraz, la geografía y el arte de esfumarse justo antes de que la atrapen.

suspects.name: Mirtha LeGrandTheftAuto
suspects.other: invites her victims to lunch before stealing their valuables
suspects.bio: TV legend turned art thief. Priceless antiques vanish between courses; her victims get invited to lunch.

es.other: invita a sus víctimas a almorzar antes de robarles sus pertenencias
es.bio: Leyenda de la tele y ladrona de arte: hace desaparecer antigüedades entre plato y plato. Sus víctimas, invitadas.

suspects.name: Richard Fortune
suspects.other: insists he is worth more than the entire national treasury
suspects.bio: Fabulously rich, yet steals things he could easily buy. Believes money solves absolutely everything.

es.other: insiste en que vale más que todo el tesoro nacional
es.bio: Millonario que roba cosas que podría comprarse tranquilamente. Cree que con plata se arregla todo.

suspects.name: Javier Chainsawman
suspects.other: occasionally threatens to dismantle the entire economy
suspects.bio: Self-proclaimed economic genius and chainsaw enthusiast. Wanted for dismantling economies and the odd sofa.

es.other: a veces amenaza con desmantelar toda la economía
es.bio: Autoproclamado genio de la economía y fanático de la motosierra. Buscado por desmantelar economías y algún sillón.

suspects.name: Guille Francachella
suspects.other: laughs suspiciously whenever someone mentions money
suspects.bio: Master of impersonation, given away every time by an uncontrollable laugh at the worst possible moment.

es.other: se ríe sospechosamente cada vez que alguien menciona plata
es.bio: Maestro de la imitación, siempre delatado por una risa incontrolable en el peor momento posible.

suspects.name: Cashteena Kitchen
suspects.other: has an unusually large collection of expensive handbags
suspects.bio: Political operator with a gift for making inconvenient evidence disappear. Owns a great many handbags.

es.other: tiene una colección sospechosamente grande de carteras de lujo
es.bio: Operadora política con un don para hacer desaparecer pruebas incómodas. Tiene muchísimas carteras.

suspects.name: Lupin III
suspects.other: always leaves a calling card at the scene of the crime
suspects.catchphrase: The world's most wanted thief strikes again!
suspects.bio: Gentleman thief and grandson of Arsène Lupin. Announces his heists in advance, just to make it interesting.

es.other: siempre deja una tarjeta de presentación en la escena del crimen
es.bio: Ladrón de guante blanco, nieto de Arsène Lupin. Anuncia sus golpes de antemano, para darle emoción.

suspects.name: Guybrush Threepwood
suspects.other: claims to be a mighty pirate despite being afraid of almost everything
suspects.bio: Self-proclaimed mighty pirate with a gift for trouble, elaborate insults and surviving almost anything.

es.other: afirma ser un temible pirata aunque le tiene miedo a casi todo
es.bio: Autoproclamado temible pirata, con talento para meterse en líos, insultar con estilo y sobrevivir a todo.

suspects.name: Ada LoveLarceny
suspects.other: writes elaborate algorithms to plan her robberies
suspects.catchphrase: The Analytical Engine has calculated your defeat!
suspects.bio: Wrote the first computer programs. Now plans heists with algorithms centuries ahead of their time.

es.other: escribe algoritmos elaborados para planificar sus robos
es.bio: Escribió los primeros programas informáticos. Hoy planea robos con algoritmos adelantados a su época.

suspects.name: Florence Night-robber
suspects.other: only operates at night and carries an unusually large medical bag
suspects.catchphrase: I shall leave no stone unturned... or safe unopened.
suspects.bio: Uses her nursing reputation to get into guarded buildings at night, and is gone before the morning shift.

es.other: solo opera de noche y lleva un maletín médico sospechosamente grande
es.bio: Usa su fama de enfermera para entrar de noche a edificios custodiados y se esfuma antes del turno de la mañana.

suspects.name: Samus Arson
suspects.other: wears an extremely expensive suit of powered armour
suspects.bio: Intergalactic bounty hunter turned outlaw. Do not attempt an arrest without planetary insurance.

es.other: usa una armadura robótica extremadamente costosa
es.bio: Cazarrecompensas intergaláctica devenida delincuente. No intentar detenerla sin un seguro planetario.
